snippet: Hands-on sessions provide educators, nonprofits, and community leaders with an accessible resource to foster year-round cyber awareness and build more resilient communities.

title: Survey Finds High-Profile Executives Feel Untouchable as Digital Exposure Turns Into Physical Risk
snippet: 360 Privacy finds more than 8 in 10 security and wealth professionals say cybersecurity and physical security can no longer be separated.

title: Decades-Old Windows Utility Powers Modern ClickFix Attack
snippet: The attack uses malicious Google search results related to Amazon and leverages the "finger" utility to launch a CAPTCHA that installs malware, including the Lumma stealer.

title: ZDI-26-785: FreeBSD Kernel Shared Memory Time-Of-Check Time-Of-Use Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
snippet: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of FreeBSD Kernel. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 7.8. The following CVEs are assigned: CVE-2026-58094.
